title: Deliver Coal to Saningbury Power Station
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Coal** delivered to **Saningbury Power Station** (industry id 45, near tile 206,7).

A likely supplier is **Saningbury Coal Mine** (industry id 34, near tile 187,10); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **410 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
